name: 211 San Diego
excerpt: If you need a place to stay tonight or in the near future, please call 211
description: Ask about local services and which organization can help. A referral is not a reserved bed or an available home.

name: County housing assistance (HACSD)
description: For a County case, ask about your current instructions or an assisted contact method. New County HCV and Public Housing waiting-list applications are closed in the reviewed directions.

name: San Diego Housing Commission (SDHC)
description: This is SDHC’s main number and staff directory. Ask to be connected to the team handling your application. The contact page also links an assistance request form. No response time or opening is promised.

name: Legal Aid Society of San Diego
sourceTitle: Legal Aid Society of San Diego: published legal-help number
description: Ask about help with a housing notice or deadline. The organization determines services, eligibility and representation. BridgeBack does not interpret a notice or calculate a legal response date.

name: VA information route for homeless veterans
excerpt: Please call the Veterans Affairs (VA) office (877) 424-3838
description: The County directs veterans to this VA number for information. Ask about assessment and referrals; a voucher or appointment is not confirmed.
